summary: Planned office/laboratory block on the Potrero Power Station masterplan with a flat 130 ft height limit; residential uses are not permitted here; no design review approval or construction start found.

milestones.text: Completion expected: SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table lists Block 3 in Phase 2 with vertical development 2029-2031 (Block 3 is not in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list: Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15)
milestones.basis_note: Phase 2 in the October 2020 revised phasing, as reported by SocketSite (Oct 9, 2020), whose 'Re-Phase Program, Detailed Construction Schedule' table lists Block 3 vertical development 2029-2031; a 2020 forecast now six years old, not a Block 3-specific commitment; no design review or construction start found.

milestones.text: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement that first names Block 3 as a development block under the adopted Design for Development's Land Use Table; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date

facts.value: Non-Retail Sales/Services (office) and Laboratory/Life Science uses permitted; Residential Not Permitted (D4D final Table 3.1.1)
flat 130 ft max per the D4D's Figure 6.2.3

As adopted in the D4D (Table 3.1.1, note 13), one or more of Blocks 2, 3, 11, 12 or 15 had to be deed-restricted for Life Science/Laboratory uses under the Development Agreement's Phasing Plan; on July 28, 2022 the Planning Commission (Resolution No. 21156) approved deleting the Phasing Plan section that required one building of not less than 130,000 sq ft to be dedicated to Life Science uses, so that requirement was removed. Laboratory and Life Science uses remain permitted here.
Not listed among the six Phase 1 blocks (2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) named in the 2024 annual compliance report

open_questions: No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 3; it is not one of the six buildings named in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list (Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), and no later-phase design review approval was found either.
Block 3's 2029-2031 window comes from a 2020 press table (SocketSite); no current Block 3 schedule was found.
